facts.fact: The Port Autonome de Dakar and the Direction générale des Douanes announced a pilot phase from 2 January 2026 of electronic exchange of Bons à Délivrer via the electronic port single window, following a June 2025 data-exchange protocol with GAINDE 2000.

note: Article only plans GAINDE installation at Gambian posts and future API exchange; no stated in-service Senegal declaration processing.
Only tax administration (DGID) work is described; no customs system stated.

facts.fact: Senegal's customs director general said in June 2024 that the GAINDE system has been in force since that year at Rosso, Ziguinchor, Sénoba and Kaolack, with all clearance offices to follow within six months.
GIE GAINDE 2000 marked 20 years of ORBUS, the single window for foreign-trade formalities, run with customs and clearance actors in Senegal.

note: Senegal has finished tests and is only preparing to put SIGMAT into operation.
Senegal is named only as a future partner country; no customs system fact.
A delegate called for SIGMAT to be extended to this country; no statement of its customs processing is given.
Document is about a cybersecurity portal, nothing on customs.
Database record; both claims are already held.
